When a genetic condition threatened to take her out of the fight, Leilani "50/50" Tupoula joined an experimental bionics program and was equipped with cybernetic limbs that gave her enhanced reflexes, precision, and endurance. Convinced she’s living on borrowed time, this fierce fighter makes every second count. 

She brings a vital humanity to Specter One that keeps her teammates sane and grounded. Tough, resourceful, with an armor-plated heart of gold, 50’s the soul of her team.
hash_7d49275b799b4e84:
Capt. Nora Anderson is a decorated Air Force veteran whose exploits are legendary across the special forces community. Her unique skill-set combines piloting impossible strike missions with the ability to lead surgical, boots-on-the-ground operations. 

She earned the trust of her teammates and a reputation for being cool under fire through her years of classified combat experience. Her mission first mindset is a force multiplier in any battlespace.
hash_591fee13700f3108:
Major Mackenzie Carver comes from a family line of military excellence and distinguished himself with exceptional skill and commitment to his country and brothers-in-arms. Despite being stripped of his rank, he maintained his mental and physical discipline throughout his incarceration, determined to restore his reputation.

Carver leaves Janus Towers with his fury at the Dark Aether sharpened, reforged into a burning clarity of purpose. No longer content to follow orders, he embraces the role of protector, seeking to carve out a future where humanity can stand on its own, free of masters mortal or cosmic.
hash_697a561db435b89f:
Tank Dempsey is a battle-hardened Marine who most recently fought through the jungles of 1968 Vietnam with grit, sarcasm, and a relentless will to survive. 

In this fractured reality, his distrust of his new companions and the unfamiliar surroundings have turned this otherwise dependable soldier into an unpredictable wild card.
hash_6279b45906e429b7:
A technological visionary, Gideon Falkner was handpicked by Emma Kagan to head the Guild’s bio-engineering team – a role that exposed him to the shadowy world of the corporation’s clandestine operations. 

Though publicly known as a scientific savant, Falkner has also proven a gifted field agent, though his prolonged exposure to a wide array of neurotoxins in his lab work have left him paranoid and erratic. Regardless, he remains one of Kagan’s favored tools within the Guild.
hash_6ab57d3565687d54:
A highly educated and brilliant scientist, Dr. Elizabeth Grey is renowned for her groundbreaking discoveries in the study of Aetherium. However, turbulent events and sinister uses of her discoveries led her down a dark path. Transformed by years of imprisonment at the hand of the former Director of Requiem, she uses her genius and scientific mind to ensure her team maintains every tactical advantage. 

Grey walks away from Janus Towers with her victories tempered by a growing unease; the gnawing doubt that science may not be able to truly mend the damage it has wrought. Once a steadfast believer in reason, she now is starting to suspect that survival may demand something beyond the equations and experiments that once brought her comfort.
hash_53220d35a0b12438:
A tech genius born into the era of AI, Anika Grimm took to building and piloting autonomous drones as naturally as breathing. Now employed by the Guild to oversee production and deployment of their vast drone fleets, she is one of Emma Kagan’s most trusted hands, and has also earned recognition as a highly capable field agent specializing in battlefield reconnaissance and assessment. 

Though she isn’t one to make friends, Grimm’s coworkers value her for her cunning mind, perceptive eye, and ruthless commitment to getting the job done.
hash_37d3d62effd12f6c:
Harper’s approach hasn’t changed much over the course of his career: get in clean, keep the team tight, finish what you start. His combat record proves the effectiveness of this approach, with more operational hours clocked and more successful missions than anyone in his unit. 

Blunt, direct, and fiercely loyal, he is respected across JSOC for his consistency and tactical awareness. When chaos hits, he’s the kind of soldier you want on your side of the firing line.
hash_26ccab67c5d8745f:
Ciro Jurado operates with a swagger that demands attention. While others may brand him a bellicose loose-cannon, below the surface he’s a cunning tactician with an elite skillset honed by relentless training. When he goes loud, he delivers brutal, almost feral violence capable of shattering enemy morale and turning the momentum. 

While his methods don’t make him many friends, his unquestionable efficacy on the battlefield makes him invaluable to his employer.
hash_1060008c2e13e170:
CEO of transnational private security corporation The Guild, Emma Kagan is relentless in her pursuit of global market dominance. Though she started as a humble analyst, Kagan’s business acumen and talent for manipulating office politics aided her rapid rise to the highest echelons of the company. 

She developed a reputation as a formidable ally, but was quick to drop those that held her back. The old guard executives fueled Kagan’s rise to power, only to be ousted by the very ambition they had come to admire.
hash_3355128c89eac32e:
Chloe “Karma” Lynch’s transition from code-breaker to mission command came shortly after the 2025 Menendez attacks, where her technical skillset and cool head under pressure proved invaluable to recovery efforts. Her innate tactical instincts are matched by a deep understanding of the modern connected battlefield, and her ability to cut through the noise keeps her teams alive and on mission. 

With her broad experience, Karma knows when to lead, when to delegate, and when to get her hands back on the terminal, making her the ideal choice to oversee JSOC’s field operations.
hash_35be9e98c7c7afe5:
Following in the footsteps of her brother, Wei Lin graduated medical school and joined the army, where she distinguished herself during dangerous peacekeeping and disaster relief operations, saving countless lives under fire and forging a reputation for herself that would eventually lead to a collaboration with JSOC. 

Known for her personal resilience, dedication to rigorous study, and higher sense of duty, Lin is a battlefield enigma – an experienced soldier who can save a life as easily as taking one.
hash_2d683b607771b5c0:
Determined to serve like his father before him, David "Section" Mason rose through the military ranks and now leads Specter One: an elite counterterrorism unit defending the world from high-risk threats.  His bold tactics and battlefield instincts are tempered by a deep responsibility for the lives of his teammates. 

Guarded, precise, and operating with complete control, David is as comfortable running point for the JSOC team as he is back home at his dad’s cabin in Alaska.
hash_62ff7860964180d9:
Trained in the family business of smuggling since she was a child, Maya Aguinaldo brings stealth, covert tactics, and a sharp mind to every engagement.

Her pursuit of the Syndicate that abducted her brother threw her into Requiem’s path when she helped free their leaders on Terminus Island. Though out of her depth in the science and machinations of the Dark Aether, her grit, grief, and hard-earned street instincts made her an essential ally in a fight far larger than her own.

Uncertain of her role within her new found ‘family’, the events of Janus Towers removed her luxury of choice, as once again she has to throw in with allies old and new if she is to have any chance of survival.
hash_255d47969b469661:
Soviet tank commander Nikolai Belinski arrives in the Dark Aether from the brutal, mountainous landscape of 1984 Afghanistan, where duty, disillusionment, and misfortune collided.

Scarred by war and haunted both by betrayal and his own decisions, he masks his bitterness with dark humor, yet remains a steadfast warrior when the shells begin to fall.
hash_3dfa3c5fbcfd47ba:
Slade “Razor” Barrick is an American-trained former private security contractor turned JSOC operative. A highly capable soldier with a large ego and a flair for bravado, he leads the special ops squad Specter Two. Though often assigned jobs in support of David Mason’s Specter One team, Razor insists his squad is every bit as capable of leading operations to success. 

Tough and resourceful, Razor is a menace on the battlefield, and while some among JSOC leadership worry about his loose leadership style, no one can question his results.
hash_79802ecf47fbdd89:
Experimental War Robot 3 - nicknamed “Reaper” in homage to the callsign of the program’s human operator - represents a breakthrough in human-robot engineering. An advanced combat platform operated remotely by a highly decorated veteran, the Reaper EWR-3 system combines state-of-the-art engineering and robotic precision with real-time human decision making to provide an elite tactical advantage in hostile environments. 

Unlike similar systems, the operator maintains a full battlefield presence through the integrated cranial connection, providing a unique opportunity for the retired combatant to return to action.
hash_53c87722046690c2:
Dr. Edward Richtofen, a brilliant but unhinged scientist and hero of the Reich, finds himself torn from 1945 in a world where the axis powers triumphed over the allied nations.

Shaped by ambition and tainted by corruption, he masks his innate sadism and considerable ego behind quick wit and a charming smile. He vows that reality itself will ultimately bow to his designs.
hash_64bc748b13a2f552:
Eric Samuels was part of President Bosworth’s Secret Service detail responsible for safely transporting her through Los Angeles during Menendez's drone attacks in 2025 - a battle in which Samuels fought alongside experienced NAVY SEAL and JSOC operatives David Mason and Mike Harper. Old school and tough as nails, Samuels' peers look to him for leadership and strength in times of crisis. 

His ability to spot threats well before they materialize, coupled with his cool head in a firefight, make him an exceptional protector -  qualities that enabled his transition to a Delta Force operative and eventual recruitment into Specter One.
hash_7b09414ba2e5b9c2:
Takeo Masaki is a disgraced ronin who wandered 1591 Feudal Japan without master or honor, carrying the weight of his exile as a yoke he cannot cast off. 

Bound by a code he only still barely believes in, he seeks redemption in the chaos of battle – his blade both a burden he must bear, and a judgment on his enemies.
hash_2e445dd12a206c65:
Originally assigned as a civilian bus driver, T.E.D.D. has spent an unknown amount of time stranded in a hostile, alien dimension - the Dark Aether. This experience has significantly impacted his mental state. 

Known for erratic outbursts and fits of unpredictable violence, his psychological instability, while concerning, has made him an effective combatant. The robotic bus driver is best approached with caution – and a valid ticket.
hash_40062275327ba679:
A hardened South African recon specialist, Axel Vermaak’s years of dangerous scout work make him an ideal addition to the JSOC squad. Composed and devastatingly efficient, he is as proficient in a firefight as he is at gathering intel. 

Originally recruited for his ability to track terrorist threats in the field, his tactical instincts and poise under pressure have made him an invaluable asset in the fight against the Guild.
hash_60cb9439dfd1eb21:
A Ranger-trained CIA operative, Grigori Weaver’s combat acumen and espionage know-how have carried him through countless engagements. After his mother defected from the former Soviet Union, Weaver dedicated his life to exceptional military service in clandestine operations. Haunted by tactical errors and driven by a desire to fight for something he believes in, Weaver stands strong with those who fight beside him.

Weaver has been transformed by the fall of Janus Towers – no longer a shadowy spy master, he has become a hardened leader forged by sacrifice. With Requiem shattered, he gathers the broken pieces in the fight against the Dark Aether, determined to ensure his friends survive.
hash_3ec03d4f5bec9ddf:
Deadly precision, unbreakable composure, and a steady hand define Priya Zaveri. At home with a rifle to her shoulder, she is the Guild’s highest rated marksman – and their highest paid. In the field, she’s often found at elevation, picking off targets with brutally accurate kill shots, though she’s equally at home with CQB and heavy weaponry. 

A top-rated performer all her life, she’s hard to impress and isn’t afraid to make her disdain known through a caustic retort or a high-velocity round – depending on the situation.

sat_weapon/sat_ar_condor_desc: Full-auto assault rifle. Exceptional mobility and handling, but high recoil and limited range.
sat_weapon/sat_ar_eagle_desc: Full-auto assault rifle. Excellent accuracy and range, offset by its slower mobility and rate of fire.
sat_weapon/sat_ar_falcon_desc: 3-round burst assault rifle. Great damage and recoil control. Average mobility and slower handling.
sat_weapon/sat_ar_hawk_desc: Full-auto assault rifle. Well-rounded in its power, accuracy, and handling.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_AR_KITE_DESC: Full-auto assault rifle. Very high damage and low vertical recoil, but high horizontal recoil and slow handling.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_AR_VULTURE_DESC: Full-auto assault rifle. Respectable damage and integrated underbarrel grenade launcher. Offset by moderate recoil, mobility, and handling.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_DM_KARA_DESC: 2-round burst marksman rifle. Exceptional damage and range, but low mobility and fire rate.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_DM_OMAN_DESC: Semi-auto marksman rifle. Very high damage and average handling. Limited by double-action fire delay.
sat_weapon/sat_dm_scotia_desc: 4-round burst marksman rifle. Extreme rate of fire within the burst, balanced by moderate burst cooldown.
sat_weapon/sat_la_fang_desc: Hybrid launcher. Locks on to vehicles and scorestreaks, while also capable of accurate free-fire.
sat_weapon/sat_la_polis_desc: Charge launcher. Hold trigger to charge an energy beam that pierces enemies. Deals high damage to vehicles and scorestreaks.
sat_weapon/sat_lm_hades_desc: Full-auto light machine gun. Great damage and high ammo count, limited by slower mobility and handling.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_LM_ZEUS_DESC: Full-auto light machine gun. Very fast fire rate, with excellent mobility and handling. Offset by higher recoil and shorter range.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_ME_KNIFE_DESC: Melee weapon. High damage, short range, and fast attack speed.
sat_weapon/sat_me_shockbaton_desc: Melee weapon. High damage, short to moderate range, and moderate attack speed.
sat_weapon/sat_pi_atlas_desc: Full-auto pistol. High damage and rate of fire, but high recoil and shorter effective ranges.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_PI_ORION_DESC: 3-round burst pistol. High damage and controllable recoil, with a moderate effective range.
sat_weapon/sat_pi_timir_desc: Semi-auto pistol. Reliable sidearm with a very fast rate of fire and low recoil.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_SH_AKITA_DESC: Full-auto shotgun. Excellent mobility and handling, balanced by high recoil and short range.
sat_weapon/sat_sh_corso_desc: Pump-action charge shotgun. Optionally hold trigger to improve hip and ADS spread.
sat_weapon/sat_sh_husky_desc: Rechambering double-barrel shotgun. Great range and high damage potential with back-to-back shots.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_SM_COBRA_DESC: Full-auto submachine gun. Very high damage and excellent mobility and handling. Very high recoil and limited range.
sat_weapon/sat_sm_komodo_desc: Full-auto submachine gun. Extreme rate of fire, but limited range and slower handling.
sat_weapon/sat_sm_orca_desc: Full-auto submachine gun. Solid balance of CQB power, handling, and recoil.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_SM_OTTER_DESC: 3-round burst submachine gun. Rewards upper body and headshots in close quarters, with decent handling and mobility. Below average range.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_SM_PUMA_DESC: Full-auto submachine gun. Very high ammo count, with respectable range and recoil. Below average damage for its class.
sat_weapon/sat_sm_zebra_desc: Full-auto submachine gun. Very low recoil and decent range for the class. Offset by low damage, especially at longer ranges.
sat_weapon/sat_sn_baltic_desc: 3-round burst sniper rifle. High power and low recoil, but slower handling and short pre-fire delay. Hold [{+breath_sprint;+holdbreath}] while ADS to steady.
SAT_WEAPON/SAT_SN_CASPIAN_DESC: Semi-auto sniper rifle. High power and stable recoil, but low fire rate.
sat_weapon/sat_sn_drake_desc: Bolt-action sniper rifle.  Quick rechamber. Moderate recoil and stability.  Hold [{+breath_sprint;+holdbreath}] while ADS to steady.
